title: Ephyra: A Property-Based Testing Framework for the LLM Era
abstract: arXiv:2611.23282v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents now write a growing share of software tests; however, property-based testing (PBT) libraries are designed with historical considerations. We present Ephyra, a PBT library in Rust built on three concepts: customizability, observability and generator synthesis. Ephyra lets users compose their own testing loops from generation, mutation and shrinking, and synthesize these components to satisfy functional predicates. Applying Ephyra to 14 open source systems, we have found 349 bugs and reported 300 of them, in database management systems (SQLite, Turso, PostgreSQL, DuckDB, DataFusion), the verified policy engine (Cedar), the SQL equivalence prover (QED), the URL parser used in Node.js (ada-url), reimplementations of existing open source systems in Rust (coreutils, brush, gitoxide), and compilers (binaryen, OCaml, and OxCaml).

translated_title: Ephyra：面向大语言模型时代的基于属性的测试框架
translated_abstract: 编码智能体现在编写了越来越多的软件测试；然而，现有的基于属性的测试库都是基于历史考量设计的。我们提出了Ephyra，一个基于三个核心概念构建的Rust语言基于属性测试库：可定制性、可观察性和生成器合成。Ephyra让用户可以从生成、变异和收缩中组合出自己的测试循环，并合成这些组件以满足功能性谓词。将Ephyra应用于14个开源系统，我们发现了349个漏洞并报告了其中300个，涵盖数据库管理系统、经过验证的策略引擎、SQL等价性证明器、Node.js中使用的URL解析器、现有开源系统的Rust重实现版本以及编译器。
tldr: Ephyra是一个面向大语言模型时代的Rust语言基于属性测试框架，以可定制性、可观察性和生成器合成为核心特性，在14个开源系统中发现了349个漏洞。
en_tdlr: Ephyra is a Rust property-based testing framework for the LLM era, built on customizability, observability, and generator synthesis, which uncovered 349 bugs across 14 open-source systems.
